create.name: Alice Berno
create.bio:
Alice Berno, who publishes on Insight Timer as MysticAly and on YouTube as The Priestess Whispers, is an Italian spiritual guide, yoga and breathwork teacher and trained massage therapist based in Cellio, a village in the hills of Piedmont. She has spent around fifteen years exploring alternative spiritual practice and describes herself as a mystic, with a strong pull towards energy work and many years of experience of what she calls the spirit world. Under the name Donna Medicina she gathers her work around the image of a garden: preparing the ground so that a person can finally bloom.

Her teaching mixes guided meditation, breath, chakra work, toning with the voice and reflective talks in both English and Italian. Recurring themes include balancing masculine and feminine energy within oneself, finding a sense of purpose, the old Hermetic principles of polarity and gender, and stories such as the Grail knight Perceval used as maps for inner growth. She holds residential retreats in Piedmont, offers a free introductory call to people thinking of working with her, and has written a short practical manual in Italian. She also releases her own music, and her Insight Timer courses include a series on the throat chakra and authentic expression.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 4.8k (profile, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube @The.Priestess.Whispers 2.13K (channel header, 1 Nov 2026); no Instagram/Facebook linked → ~6.9k total → local_hero
flags: Health rule unsure, so written and flagged: her Insight Timer bio says she 'heals with her voice' and specialises in neurodivergent and autistic people; her free manual and two Insight Timer courses are framed around 'survival mode' and the nervous system as 'the foundation for any kind of healing', and several videos are about nervous-system healing and mental illness. All of those are left out, but a human should decide whether the overall presentation falls under the strict health rule.

Name: she appears as 'MysticAly' (Insight Timer), 'Alice B' (Insight Timer bio), 'Donna Medicina' (Linktree) and 'The Priestess Whispers' (YouTube); the surname Berno comes only from her PayPal link on the Linktree. Listed as Alice Berno following the real-name precedent.

No website of her own; website_url and booking_url are her Linktree. The retreat page (Canva) shows only the title 'Il ritiro di Settembre', so no retreat could be listed and in-person availability rests on the Linktree and a YouTube retreat clip.
Some YouTube content is light or novelty (e.g. a 'spell to get my ex back' clip, 'manifest a specific person'); those were not chosen, but the channel is linked.
Only one photo confirmed (Linktree avatar, 600x600); the YouTube avatar is a half-face crop.
left_out: Insight Timer courses 'Exiting Survival Mode, Feeling Safe The Foundation For Any Kind Of Healing' (and Italian version): framed as healing and nervous-system regulation (health rule).
Insight Timer course 'Comprehend And Use The Power Of Your Menstrual Cycle' (and Italian version): borderline bodily-health topic, left out.
Italian throat chakra course: duplicate of the English one.
Manual 'Uscire dalla Modalità di Sopravvivenza': only on amazon.it (B0G53972W2), amazon.com /dp/ returned 500; title is also survival-mode/nervous-system framed.
September retreat in Piedmont: Canva page has no dates or details; September 2026 has passed.
Free call: no page of its own to link.
Videos on nervous-system healing, mental illness, oracle-card monthly guidance (dated), music-only tracks, subliminals and short clips under ~3 minutes.
